e7GlossaryMcpExplanation: Model Context Protocol. Small add-on servers that give the agent extra tools, like a browser, a database, or a design tool. You connect them once and every session can use them.

@e7GlossaryMcpExplanation.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

@e7GlossaryWorktreeTerm.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

e7GlossaryWorktreeExplanation: A separate checkout of the same repository. Use one when you want the agent to try something on its own branch without touching the code you are working in.

@e7GlossaryWorktreeExplanation.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

e7GlossaryProviderExplanation: The company that hosts a model, such as Anthropic, OpenAI or a local runtime. Each one needs its own API key or login.

@e7GlossaryProviderExplanation.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

@e7GlossaryContextTerm.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

e7GlossaryContextExplanation: Everything the model can see right now: your messages, files it read, and tool results. It has a size limit. When it fills up, older parts are summarised so the session can continue.

@e7GlossaryContextExplanation.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

@e7GlossaryAgentTerm.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

e7GlossaryAgentExplanation: A named set of instructions and permissions the model works under. The default one can read and edit code. Others might only plan, or only review.

@e7GlossaryAgentExplanation.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

e7GlossaryReasoningExplanation: The model’s working notes before it answers. Useful for seeing why it made a choice. Hidden by default to keep the conversation short.

@e7GlossaryReasoningExplanation.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

@e7GlossaryPermissionTerm.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

e7GlossaryPermissionExplanation: Before the agent runs a command or edits a file outside what it is already allowed, it asks you. Allow once, or always for that pattern.

@e7GlossaryPermissionExplanation.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

@e7GlossaryVariantTerm.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface

e7GlossaryVariantExplanation: A speed-versus-depth setting for the model, such as how long it may think before answering.

@e7GlossaryVariantExplanation.description: Localized shared connection or glossary interface
